cache_contract: E_joint/E_own bind exact pre-correction E_stage CACHE_FREEZE plus payload and producer job/arm/seed/source/plan/data/donor origin. MODEL_FREEZE and final FREEZE bind this cache because state_dict omits H/z.

correction.base_policy: Only source-held-VALID selected complete1100 native donor may be frozen; capture H,z from actual native forward classifier hook. E_joint/E_own must reuse E_stage pre-correction cache exactly. U_stage own4 acquired frozen donor caches. S_paths live base has no cache.
correction.loss: own CE +2*Brier(mean probabilities), literal per-route normalization; interleaved same per-route loss with common pre-update deterministic peer outputs
correction.private_architecture: raw300->512 affine +H; full512 GAT/source root+h/gate/LayerNorm block; dense512->10 residual. No rank2/SVD/error-band filter/reweighting.
correction.private_init: Full independently drawn native graph units, zero dense output weight+bias; output learns first, incoming units wake afterward
correction.single: Full live native donor +four512 raw-feature graph paths +2048->512->10 nonlinear joint decoder; zero output init, all paths and full backbone train. Preserve selected native optimizer states and live end1100 dropout stream. Checkpointed native/path forward re-execution is paid.

cost_limits: All donor epochs,400 private updates per corrected bank,4 deterministic peer serving passes per bank_epoch, actual enabled diagnostic VJPs, nativeSingle100 extra full passes, checkpoint rematerialization, caches, snapshots and selectors paid. Root binds conservative finite caps for complete schedules before launch; actual epoch/runtime/memory costs are logged during fitting. No discarded cost prerequisite.

development_decision.competence_and_loss: Require candidate mean member accuracy no more than0.25pp below I_native's mean member accuracy; also no candidate member loses more than1.0pp from its own frozen native donor on the complete VALID population. Require mean served NLL not worse than each of S_continue,S_paths,I_native. Report every seed/member accuracy,NLL and Brier. These fixed tolerances are proposed before any outcome; own CE is not a competence certificate.
development_decision.confirmation: A positive development screen only warrants a separately frozen, unused confirmation population or fresh graph/task before a predictive claim. It is not permission to open TEST here or infer statistical significance from three dependent seed comparisons.
development_decision.error_analysis: Before endpoint predictions, define donor-pool baseline error cohorts and class/degree supports. Report donor pool wrong->candidate correct repairs, correct->wrong introduced errors, wrong->different-wrong churn, and the same flows on the donor all-members-wrong/common-competitor cohort. All four candidate members initially equal p0; common-error support is therefore the native donor error cohort, not four independent observations. Retain paired probability loss/confidence changes.
development_decision.no_go: Missing/failed/capped required cell, no complete served quality gain, calibration-only improvement, lower common overlap with worse member competence, or S_paths/I_native matching the useful gain stops promotion of this extension. Do not change the architecture, residual coefficient, order or endpoint after a failed complete comparison.
development_decision.population: Full official WikiCS split0 VALID union stopping mask,5274 nodes; TRAIN580. Seeds17,29,43. No TEST label read. These shared graph/mask seed replications are development and are not independent graph replications.
development_decision.primary: Complete served accuracy; no subgroup can substitute. Proposed minimal useful mean gain is0.5 percentage points versus the strongest of S_continue,S_paths,I_native,E_joint,E_own. Mean gains versus every required quality reference must be positive and every paired-seed gain versus each must be strictly positive. The0.5pp threshold is a prospective practical choice, not a significance claim.
development_decision.selection: Retain source-native best-VALID selectors during native acquisitions exactly as declared. Every changed residual predictor is assessed at its fixed final correction endpoint. No stagewise validation selection. Freeze every final model/probability artifact before the once-only comparative endpoint analysis; source acquisition selection already used VALID and remains explicit.
development_decision.sharing_attribution: A nonpositive mean gain or any paired-seed nonpositive gain versus U_stage leaves no demonstrated quality value of the common frozen backbone. At most report its measured storage/compute tradeoff; do not claim sharing-specific accuracy superiority.
development_decision.staging_attribution: A nonpositive mean gain or any paired-seed nonpositive gain versus E_joint closes the sequential-freezing explanation. The analogous failure versus E_own closes the served-residual addition explanation, even if extra private capacity helps.

native_selected_replay_metadata_limit: Native v3 SELECTED_REPLAY source_and_checkpoint_hashes_verified=True is not pre-load expected-checkpoint certification. Donor custody uses root-bound NATIVE_FREEZE and rehashed selected/end files. Recorded numerical variation does not trigger reselection.
novelty: Known staged boosting/shared-early-private-late/residual ancestry; no novelty or quality claim
numerical_status: NOT_RUN by this agent. Preserved native-v1 failure and residual-v1 fixture failure remain honestly recorded. Strict numerical implementations retained unchanged as optional later TRAIN-only diagnostics; no failed check is passed.
qualification: Actual first complete native local/global epoch, first private update for each of four paths, or first complete capable-single epoch emits TRAIN_SMOKE evidence. These are scheduled training updates, not extra qualification updates. Finite losses/active gradients, absent inactive-native gradients, finite updated parameters and serving probabilities are checked during actual fitting. Source/data/runtime/custody and real bug blockers retained. Strict parity and discarded cost probes are optional diagnostics, not fitting prerequisites.
